$comment: Sample owner-attestation response set for the FNF manifest-opaque tier, consumed by scripts/Convert-AttestationToCapabilityRows.ps1. Each response is keyed by the REAL Microsoft 365 Agent Registry bot/agent id (NOT a provisional manifest stem such as 'declarativeAgent'). 'peopleCapable' records whether the owner confirmed the declarative-agent People capability ('Reference org chart and profile info') is enabled - accepted: yes/no (also y/n, true/false, 1/0, enabled/disabled). Optional fields: agentName, environmentId, attestedBy (owner UPN), attestedAt (ISO 8601), attestationId (ticket/survey response id), notes. The converter emits a capability artifact shape-compatible with detect_people_capability.py, stamping peopleCapableSource=attested. Illustrative example identities only. The converter accepts a bare array, this { responses: [...] } wrapper, or a { value: [...] } envelope.
